headline.caveat: Price undisclosed. 20-year PPA for the full 835MW output of the Crane Clean Energy Center (Three Mile Island Unit 1 restart); analysts infer a premium to market power prices, but no dollar value is on record.

realized_to_date.caveat: No power delivered yet; restart targeted 2027 (accelerated from 2028), so no PPA cash has flowed.

nature_md: Microsoft agreed to buy the entire 835MW output of Constellation's restarted Three Mile Island Unit 1 (renamed Crane Clean Energy Center, PA) for 20 years to match data-center load in PJM with carbon-free energy attributes. Constellation is funding the ~$1.6B restart itself — the PPA, not Microsoft capital, is what de-risks the investment. Power flows to the grid; Microsoft receives energy and environmental attributes, not co-located supply. Restart was accelerated to 2027 pending NRC approval.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Microsoft books nothing until deliveries begin; the PPA then flows through cost of revenue (energy opex) for its data centers. The multi-decade commitment appears in unrecorded purchase-obligation disclosures in its 10-K, not on the balance sheet (subject to lease/derivative scoping tests).
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Constellation capitalizes the ~$1.6B restart cost and recognizes revenue only from commercial operation (2027+). The contracted offtake underpinned upgrades to its earnings guidance; no upfront payment from Microsoft is disclosed.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** the deal that proved AI demand can reopen shuttered nuclear plants — fully contracted output for 20 years with an investment-grade counterparty. **Bear:** the price is secret; if it embeds a large premium, Microsoft is pre-paying scarcity rents for power that arrives only from 2027, and restart schedules (NRC, staffing, equipment) have slipped industry-wide.

sources.title: Constellation to Launch Crane Clean Energy Center
